description: The author notes that the European Union considered, but ultimately did not adopt, a proposal for a 'presumption of causality' to aid victims of AI-related harm.

instances.assertion: The author notes that the European Union considered, but ultimately did not adopt, a proposal for a 'presumption of causality' to aid victims of AI-related harm.
The European Union has moved away from creating a new category of 'electronic personhood' for AI, focusing instead on risk-based governance under the AI Act.
